text:
Olivia: Heads up — vendor flagged an intake inspection failure on a midwave H100 top-off. Estimated delay ~3 weeks. PO# 9842. Need routing + RMA plan and quick decision on airlift vs wait.

Kai: Do we have a buffer day-wise? How many units do we need to keep Dedicated pools stable if we lose 12?

Marta: I pinged NexaSupply for an immediate partial air replace quote. Shipping-bot returned a provisional AWB/ETA if we greenlight. Trying to pull from spare pool but limited.

NexaSupply: Vendor: confirmed 12 units flagged at intake (see serials). We can air-ship 6 temporary loaners within 48–72h at +$4.2k/unit. Customs note for EU routes — HS code and invoice reqs may add 12–24h.
```
SN: H100-AB12, H100-AB13, H100-AB14, H100-AB15, H100-AB16, H100-AB17, H100-AB18, H100-AB19, H100-AB20, H100-AB21, H100-AB22, H100-AB23
```

James: If we take 6 loaners, which clusters? We should avoid cross-region transfers that blow up egress + latency. Suggest prod-eu first, prod-us-east second. Also need a quick canary plan.

Olivia: Agreed — prioritize prod-eu (SLA critical) then prod-us-east. Use loaners to replace oldest H100s in pool-3. Kai, can you approve the emergency spend? I added a link to the allocation sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/topoff-alloc (please update).

Kai: Approve up to $30k for emergency airlift. Please prepare PO addendum and confirm vendor warranty parity on loaners. No hidden exclusions.

Marta: On it. Shipping-bot attached AWB and provisional invoice. I'll ask our customs broker to pre-clear HS code 8471.80. Need commercial invoice + packing list from vendor to move.

shipping-bot: AWB ready: 1234-EXPR. Carrier: AirNow. ETA to EU depot: 48h after addendum signed. Docs pending: commercial invoice, packing list, COO. Note: add broker reference to avoid hold.

NexaSupply: We will provide warranty parity for the loaners and a 30d RMA return window. Depot will send receipt photos and serial confirmations. Need signed addendum by EOD to lock flight manifest.

Olivia: I'll sign as soon as PO update and addendum land. Marta — coordinate depot receiving checks and customs pre-clear. James — schedule canary transfer and monitor perf. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
